name: JW Marriott Panama
positioning: Ocean-view luxury hotel on the bayside of Punta Pacifica in Panama City, with an infinity pool facing the skyline
best_for: Travelers who want ocean views from every room

facts.text: The hotel is on the bayside of Punta Pacifica in Panama City, near local businesses, shops and entertainment venues.
The hotel has a resort-style infinity pool with views of the Panama City skyline.
The hotel says all its rooms and suites feature ocean views.
Rooms and suites have plush bedding and decor inspired by the coastline.
Guests can watch the sunset from a private balcony.
Suites are offered with a plunge bath.
MASI offers a live ceviche bar experience paired with local touches.
Azul is the hotel's poolside bar and restaurant, with views of Panama City.
The Executive Lounge includes breakfast, evening hors d'oeuvres, evening cocktails and desserts.
The hotel holds the Green Key international certification, an eco-label for tourism.
The hotel has a children's pool.

highlights.text: The hotel says all its rooms and suites feature ocean views.
A resort-style infinity pool looks out over the Panama City skyline.
The hotel sits on the bayside of Punta Pacifica, near shops, businesses and entertainment.
Guests can watch the sunset from a private balcony.
Suites are offered with a plunge bath.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
WhataHotel notes the urban location may lack beach access.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing typical of luxury chain hotels.
